question: Should maintainers wait for the contributor to refresh and prove this fork branch, or open a credited replacement PR on current main for the hook accountId fix?
rationale: The bug is real and the branch contains useful work, but the current PR is conflicting, uneditable by maintainers, missing live proof, and needs a current-main policy port.

options.title: Open or accept a current-main replacement
options.body: Port the useful accountId fix onto current main, credit this PR, add docs and real behavior proof, then close this branch after the replacement is viable or landed.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, enable maintainer edits, remove the changelog edit, update docs, port the policy seam, and add live proof before reassessment.

options.title: Pause until proof exists
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not land or repair it until a maintainer or contributor can provide redacted multi-account delivery proof.

recommendation.title: Open or accept a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Port the useful accountId fix onto current main, credit this PR, add docs and real behavior proof, then close this branch after the replacement is viable or landed.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent hook-specific history and was explicitly requested for review in the PR discussion.
